items.title: China's influence in the gaming industry is growing
items.titleOrig: China's influence in the gaming industry is growing
items.desc: Home to more than 700 million gamers, China is the world's largest gaming market — but it's also one of the most tightly regulated. The effects reach far beyond China, impacting players around the world.

items.title: Nord Stream: Germany puts suspected Ukrainian pipeline saboteur on trial
items.titleOrig: Nord Stream: Germany puts suspected Ukrainian pipeline saboteur on trial
items.desc: A Ukrainian citizen faces court in Hamburg, accused of attacking the Nord Stream gas pipelines in 2022. It raises questions about Kyiv's possible role in the explosions. German support for Ukraine is also under scrutiny.

items.title: Do non-German nationals commit more crimes than Germans?

items.title: The hidden treasure in discarded wearable and fast tech

items.title: Iran: Political infighting deepens as economic woes mount during war
items.titleOrig: Iran: Political infighting deepens as economic woes mount during war
items.desc: Hardliners are stepping up pressure on Iran's government and calling for Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's removal. The oil minister resigned, but that's doing little to ease the pressure on President Masoud Pezeshkian.

items.desc: Three of India's Cockroach movement leaders will spend five days in jail over charges of trespassing into what was until recently a designated protest site. In other news, Marco Rubio is set to visit India.
